title: Deploy the 2 demo gates (checkbox notice page) to Cloudflare
instructions: 1. In the Cloudflare dashboard, turn off Cloudflare Access (login) for both demo Workers. 2. In Terminal: cd out/cf-review/original && npx wrangler secret put COOKIE_KEY (paste the output of: openssl rand -hex 32) && npx wrangler deploy. 3. Same in out/cf-review/optimized with its own new random value. 4. Run the curl lines in out/cf-review/POST-DEPLOY-CHECK.txt section 1, then open each link in a browser: you should see the notice page first. Tap Done when finished, or write what failed.

result.notes: step 2 and 3, can you prepare the script for run them easier ?
